name: GenAI-Bench_image_generation_processed
description: A processed dataset for evaluating text-to-image generation systems. It contains text prompts paired with reference images and annotations to measure how well models render requested content, style, and composition. The benchmark is intended for automated and human evaluation of generative image quality and prompt faithfulness.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used for practical comparisons of image-generation models; modest visibility compared to large academic benchmarks.
